units.source_text: 藤壶母后也打开了御膳堂的纸隔扇，在一旁观赏。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo also opened the paper sliding screen of the imperial dining hall and watched from the side.

units.source_text: 这位母后深通画道，她今天出席，源氏内大臣甚感欣慰。

en.t: Because this empress mother had a deep understanding of painting, the Minister of the Left Genji felt greatly reassured by her presence today.

units.source_text: 帅皇子每逢难于判断之时，便时时向她请教，得益甚多。

en.t: Whenever Prince Sochi found it difficult to judge, he often consulted her and gained a great deal from her advice.
